templates.title: Pi-hole WD EX4100 ARMv7
templates.name: pihole-wd-ex4100
templates.description: Pi-hole adapted for WD My Cloud EX4100 ARMv7 using Alpine 3.17.10 and host networking.
templates.note: Uses host networking because Docker bridge port publishing on the EX4100 can return SERVFAIL on DNS port 53. Web UI defaults to HTTP 32768 and HTTPS 32769.

env.name: PIHOLE_PASSWORD
env.label: Pi-hole admin password
env.description: Password for the Pi-hole web interface. Change this before deployment.

env.name: WEB_SERVER_PORTS
env.label: Pi-hole web server ports
env.description: Pi-hole FTL webserver port definition for HTTP and HTTPS.
